articles.title: Toem 2: A Cozy Photo Adventure Where You Fix Pipes and Make Friends
articles.summary: Toem 2 is a chill black-and-white game where you explore a town, take photos, and solve silly problems. You get a screwdriver for your camera and help a plumber named Plum unclog pipes. It feels like a relaxing vacation.

articles.title: Netflix June 2026: Rom-Coms, Cartoons, and a Bunch of Bees!
articles.summary: Netflix is adding tons of movies and shows in June, including 'Bee Movie,' 'Sesame Street' Volume 3, and new rom-coms like 'Office Romance.' Classic wedding comedies and the 'Creed' boxing trilogy also arrive.

articles.title: Steam Deck Prices Jump Up — Here's What It Means for Your Wallet
articles.summary: Valve just raised Steam Deck prices by $200 or more. The 512GB OLED model now costs $789, and the 1TB version is $789 too. If you want one, you'll have to pay more, but Steam games often go on sale.
